[color=#faf235]Welcome to Meowgix![/color]
Defeat hordes of enemies by learning, upgrading, and combining spells.

[color=#faf235]Controls[/color]
Move: [color=#66d8fa]\[W]\[A]\[S]\[D][/color]    Aim: [color=#66d8fa]\[Mouse][/color]    Quit: [color=#66d8fa]Hold \[Esc][/color]

[color=#faf235]Gain Power[/color]
Enemies drop [color=#66d8fa]magical orbs[/color] (  ). Collect them to level up and upgrade a spell or learn a new one.

[color=#faf235]Combine Spells[/color]
When two spells reach level 3, enemies may drop an [color=#66d8fa]Arcane Book[/color] (      ).
Use it to [color=#66d8fa]combine[/color] spells of the same tier, increasing their tier by 1.

[color=#faf235]Spell Panel (left side)[/color]
                Your spells appear on the left sidebar. [color=#66d8fa]Bright dots[/color] next to
                each icon show the spell's tier, and the [color=#66d8fa]number[/color] shows its level.

[color=#faf235]Progress & Boss[/color]
The bar on the right fills as you advance.
When it reaches the top, a [color=#66d8fa]boss[/color] appears. Defeat it to move on.

[color=#66d8fa]Click anywhere[/color] to start...
